description: Zero SMP 1.9.1 performance: ModernFix dynamic resources on (models are baked when first used instead of all at startup and on every F3+T; overrides the explicit false of 1.1.1). Distant Horizons renderer on, tuned for low cost: LOD radius 32 chunks and 1 DH thread at half run time (owner's pick 2026-10-11: on the laptop 125.7 FPS / 1% low 28.3 vs 118.1 / 26.6 at radius 64 with 2 threads; DH removed 188.5 / 42.8) and below-normal priority, surface-only distant generation in singleplayer (no feature/structure generation next to the integrated server; the Zero SMP server runs no DH, so multiplayer LODs only come from chunks the client receives anyway), low horizontal quality, biome blending 1, single-pass vanilla fade, no DH SSAO, flat-colour LODs (no textured LODs) and no LOD rebuilds when zooming. ImmediatelyFast experimental screen batching on (inventory/menu screens: +24.5% FPS, +11% 1% low on the laptop, no visual change in 19 GUI scenes). Forge loads mods one at a time (fml.toml maxThreads = 1): parallel mod construction races in Create/Create Deco (Registrate) and Zeta/Supplementaries crashed about 1 launch in 15-20; costs about 1 s of startup. Client config only: the server needs nothing. DistantHorizons.toml keys name their [table]; _version = 5 keeps DH 3.3.3 from resetting an older (version 4) file to its defaults, which would drop these values (v4 and v5 only add/remove keys).
